parameters.query:
WITH input_data AS (
    SELECT $1::JSONB AS data
)

INSERT INTO automation_logs (
    workflow_name,
    execution_id,
    level,
    event_type,
    message,
    details
)

SELECT
    data->>'workflow_name',

    NULLIF(
        data->>'execution_id',
        ''
    ),

    'error',

    'workflow_execution_failed',

    data->>'error_message',

    jsonb_build_object(
        'last_node',
            data->>'last_node',

        'execution_url',
            data->>'execution_url',

        'raw_error',
            data->'details'
    )

FROM input_data

RETURNING
    id,
    workflow_name,
    execution_id,
    level,
    event_type,
    message,
    created_at;
